result.summary: The page has one clear visual defect: the hero image for the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' failed to load and shows a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon. The rest of the screen (header, search, filter chips, promo banner, carousel, bottom navigation) renders as expected.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a flat grey box with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant's cover photo. The other cards (Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, the pizza card) render their images correctly.
issues.suggestion: Check that the image URL/asset for this restaurant is valid and loads. Add a branded fallback image (e.g. a cuisine illustration) and retry logic so a failed load never exposes a broken-image icon.
